TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_PRO_TIP: Enhance your search by using logical operators like <, >, |, &, =, !=
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_1: Tip: Search for transaction IDs, addresses, tokens, labels, amounts, and dates.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_10: Tip: Combine AND (&) and OR (|) operators for more complex searches. For example > {lastYear}-01-01 & < {lastYear}-01-31 | > {lastYear}-12-01 & < {lastYear}-12-31 will show all transactions in January or December {lastYear}.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_2: Tip: Use the greater than (>) and less than (<) symbols for amount searches. For example 1 will show all transactions that have an amount of 1 and higher.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_3: Tip: Search for exact amounts using the equal (=) symbol. For example = 0.01 will show only transactions that have an amount of exactly 0.01.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_4: Tip: Exclude an amount by using the exclamation mark and equal symbols together (!=). For example != -0.01 will show all transactions except the ones with an amount of -0.01.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_5: Tip: Dates can be searched using the YYYY-MM-DD format. For example {lastYear}-12-14 will show all transactions on December 14th, {lastYear}.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_6: Tip: Use greater than (>) and lesser than (<) symbols on date searches. For example > {lastYear}-12-01 will show all transactions on and after December 1st, {lastYear}.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_7: Tip: Exclude a date by using the exclamation mark and equal symbols together (!=). For example != {lastYear}-12-14 will show all transactions except the ones on December 14th, {lastYear}.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_8: Tip: Display results matching at least one of multiple searches by grouping them with the OR operator (|). For example {lastYear}-11-30 | {lastYear}-12-01 will show all transactions that occurred on the 30th of November or the 1st of December {lastYear}.
TR_TRANSACTIONS_SEARCH_TIP_9: Tip: Display results matching multiple searches by grouping them with the AND operator (&). For example > {lastYear}-12-01 & < {lastYear}-12-31 & > 0 will show all incoming (amount higher than 0) transactions in December {lastYear}.
